output.subject: Biology
overarchingObjectives: Understand enzyme structure and function in biological systems
Apply knowledge of enzyme kinetics to real-world scenarios
Develop practical skills for investigating enzyme activity
Analyze data using scientific thinking and metacognitive approaches

lessons.title: Enzyme Structure and Function
learningObjectives: By the end, students can explain the lock and key model of enzyme action
By the end, students can describe factors affecting enzyme activity
By the end, students can investigate enzyme activity through practical experimentation

activities.title: Enzyme Structure Introduction
activities.description: Students use molecular models to visualize enzyme structure and active sites. They compare and contrast enzyme-substrate complexes with lock and key models.

activities.title: Enzyme Activity Practical
activities.description: Students conduct an experiment to investigate how temperature affects enzyme activity using amylase and starch. They follow standardized procedures and record qualitative and quantitative data.

activities.title: Data Analysis Discussion
activities.description: Students graph their results and identify patterns. They use metacognitive strategies to evaluate their experimental design and suggest improvements for accuracy.

assessment: Observation of practical skills during enzyme activity experiment
Quality of graphs and data analysis in post-practical discussion
Oral responses to questions about enzyme structure and function

extension: Research on industrial applications of enzymes
Designing controlled experiments for other factors

scaffoldingStrategies: Pre-lab vocabulary building with key terms
Model demonstrations before independent practical work
Sentence starters for data analysis and conclusions
reflectionPrompts: What surprised you about how temperature affected enzyme activity?
How could you improve your experimental design for more reliable results?
What connections can you make between today's lesson and previous biology topics?
crossCurricularLinks: Food Technology: Enzymes in food processing
stretchTasks: Research and present on a specific enzyme's role in a disease or medical treatment
Design an experiment to investigate how pH affects enzyme activity
Create a model showing the induced fit theory of enzyme action

lessons.title: Enzyme Kinetics and Inhibition
learningObjectives: By the end, students can explain competitive and non-competitive inhibition
By the end, students can analyze enzyme kinetics graphs
By the end, students can evaluate the role of enzymes in metabolic pathways

activities.title: Inhibition Mechanisms
activities.description: Students use diagrams and animations to understand competitive and non-competitive inhibition. They create visual models to compare these mechanisms and their effects on enzyme activity.

activities.title: Enzyme Kinetics Practical
activities.description: Students investigate the effect of inhibitors on enzyme activity. They collect data, calculate reaction rates, and construct graphs to analyze enzyme kinetics under different conditions.

activities.title: Metabolic Pathway Analysis
activities.description: Students examine metabolic pathways and identify key enzymes. They use metacognitive strategies to predict the effects of enzyme inhibition on these pathways and overall cellular function.

assessment: Accuracy of inhibition mechanism explanations in diagrams
Quality of enzyme kinetics graphs and interpretations
Depth of analysis in metabolic pathway case studies

extension: Research on enzyme inhibitors in medicine

scaffoldingStrategies: Think-pair-share activities before whole class discussions
reflectionPrompts: How does understanding enzyme inhibition help explain drug action?
What patterns did you notice in the enzyme kinetics data?
How might changes in enzyme activity affect an organism's survival?
crossCurricularLinks: Medicine: Drug design and enzyme inhibition
Agriculture: Pesticides and enzyme inhibition in pests
stretchTasks: Design a drug that specifically inhibits a target enzyme in a pathogen
Create a mathematical model to predict enzyme activity under various conditions
Research and present on evolutionary adaptations of enzymes in extreme environments
